name: zsnd_sample_init_from_wave_data_directsound
description: zSndSample::InitFromWaveData_DirectSound creates and fills a DirectSound backend buffer from parsed wave data.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred: current source matches behavior and now restores the explicit shift/byte-test descriptor flag shape plus closer descriptor format-pointer store ordering, but VC byte comparison still differs in DirectSound descriptor local setup, provider-call register scheduling, and marker allocation/loop tail shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4a3180 validates createGuard early return, DirectSound buffer descriptor setup from replay flags and wave format, CreateSoundBuffer error path through zError/zSnd reports, backend handle setup, GetStatus/Restore, Lock/Unlock with split-buffer PCM copy, SetCurrentPosition, cue marker allocation and timing, playbackEventHandler clearing, and replay flag bit 0x80 clearing.

The native DirectSound smoke uses fake DirectSound device/buffer vtables to verify descriptor flags/bytes/format, status/lock/unlock/current-position calls, buffer write contents, marker arrays, backend handle, playbackEventHandler clearing, and replay flag update.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a3180 still fails after DirectSound descriptor unsigned-byte predicate and lpwfxFormat store-order shaping. A focused current profile sweep found the static VC5SP3 profiles vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_oy_ob0_facs tied closest at 694 unmasked mismatches, 76 relocation-masked bytes, BN size 852, object size 848, and no trailing VC NOPs trimmed. The MD profiles vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs were worse at 734 mismatches, 68 relocation-masked bytes, BN size 852, object size 864, and 11 trailing VC NOPs trimmed. Rejected source-shape checks: direct primaryVoice.backendBuffer calls for Lock/Unlock/SetCurrentPosition worsened to 699 mismatches, removing the DirectSound cuePoints local worsened to 736 mismatches, moving the fmt local after descriptor memset worsened to 708 mismatches, passing loadedWaveData->pcmByteCount to Lock worsened to 692 mismatches. Unsigned replay flag temporaries were byte-neutral against the previous baseline; removing const from the DirectSound fmt local and adding register to it were also byte-neutral.
